the user is sending feedback: PHASE 1: Foundation + Talk Screen UI Prototype (Vite + React + Tailwind)

We are building a high-fidelity UI prototype of the language learning app “Mural” inside this Vite + React + Tailwind environment.  
This is a visual/interactive prototype only. Real API integrations (Deepgram, Groq, Supabase) will come later in a separate Next.js project.

### Goals for this phase
Create a beautiful, production-quality Talk screen that feels premium and matches the calm, modern aesthetic of the original Mural reference.

### Design Requirements
- Soft cream / off-white background (#FDFBF7 or similar)
- Soft orange → purple/pink gradient for the main orb
- Clean modern typography (use Inter or system sans-serif)
- Large touch-friendly elements
- Calm, elegant animations
- Mobile-first, but looks good on desktop too

### Exact UI to build (Talk screen)

1. \*\*Top bar\*\*
- Left: small orange circle + word “mural” (logo)
- Right: settings/sliders icon in a soft circle

2. \*\*Language pill\*\*
- Centered soft yellow/cream pill that says: “A little everyday Chinese” (or German)
- Make it easy to change later

3. \*\*Main Orb (hero element)\*\*
- Large, beautiful, soft gradient sphere in the center
- Gradient should go from warm orange → soft purple/pink
- Subtle continuous breathing / pulsing animation (Framer Motion)
- Soft glow / shadow underneath
- It should feel alive and inviting

4. \*\*Status text under the orb\*\*
- “Ready when you are”

5. \*\*Current phrase display\*\*
- Large bold text in the target language (example: “你好!” or “Hallo!”)
- Smaller English translation underneath (“Hello!”)

6. \*\*Action buttons row\*\*
- Left: “Meaning” button (soft cream circle with chat icon)
- Center: Large orange microphone button (main CTA)
- Right: “Transcript” button (soft cream circle with message icon)

7. \*\*Status text under buttons\*\*
- “Microphone off”
- “English is welcome, too.”

8. \*\*Bottom Navigation\*\*
- Fixed bottom bar with three items:
    - Talk (active state)
    - Themes
    - Words
- Use nice icons + labels
- Active state should be clearly visible

### Technical Requirements
- Use React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS
- Use Framer Motion for the orb animation and any micro-interactions
- Create clean, reusable components (Orb, BottomNav, ActionButton, etc.)
- Make the layout fully responsive
- Use proper spacing and visual hierarchy
- All interactive elements should have hover/active states
- Code should be clean and well-organized

### What NOT to do in this phase
- Do not connect any real APIs
- Do not implement actual speech recognition
- Do not add routing yet (just the Talk screen)
- Do not add authentication

### Deliverable
A polished, beautiful Talk screen that looks and feels like a real premium language app.  
The orb should be the star of the screen.

After you finish, show me the main component code and a short explanation of the structure.
